subject: Lead quality
observation: A brief says campaign Indigo cost 900 USD per qualified lead.
sources: A: Indigo spent USD 900 for 30 leads, of which 9 qualified.
reasons: USD 100 per qualified lead
USD 30 per qualified lead
USD 900 per qualified lead
repairs: replace with 100 USD and name the denominator

subject: Retail returns
observation: A weekend sale headline promises free returns for ALL products.
sources: A: A different January event covered every category.
B: For this weekend all apparel except custom apparel has free returns.
reasons: this sale excludes custom apparel
the January policy governs this weekend
all merchandise in this event qualifies
repairs: limit the line to eligible apparel and show the exception

subject: Job accounting
observation: A synthetic batch review says a second request with the same command ID should allocate another reservation.
sources: A: Each successful distinct command reserves one unit. Duplicate command IDs return the existing reservation.
B: The worker processes up to five jobs per cycle.
reasons: capacity determines idempotency
duplicate IDs reuse the first reservation
every HTTP delivery creates a reservation
repairs: reuse the existing reservation and assert one row

subject: Service isolation
observation: A design summary says an analytics outage leaves transactional profile reads available.
sources: A: Both services are hosted in one region.
B: Transactional reads use the primary database directly. Analytics receives queued events; reads do not contact it.
reasons: the reads have no dependency on analytics
events must be replayed before reads
a common region means any individual service outage stops both
repairs: move all analytics calls into reads
guarantee all regional outages are harmless

subject: Staff reports
observation: A brief asks whether contract staff may download the internal weekly report.
sources: A: Full-time staff may read this report. The published policy does not address contractors.
B: Contractors are allowed to view a different public dashboard.
reasons: the public dashboard grants internal downloads
contractor entitlement for this report is unspecified
every staff category inherits the same access
repairs: ask the report owner to confirm the specific entitlement

subject: Conversion cohort
observation: A dashboard summary describes 25 percent conversion of trial signups from May after 30 days.
sources: A: April recorded 100 signups and 50 upgrades.
B: May's 160 signups were followed for 30 days; 40 distinct signups upgraded.
reasons: April sets May's denominator
40 upgrades imply 40 percent
40 of the same 160 equals 25 percent
repairs: keep with the cohort and window attached
